item.title: Write My Talking Sale Pitch

turns.text: Make this photo of me say something about our sale. You write the line—keep it upbeat and don't invent discounts, dates or products. An 8-second square talking video, friendly male English voice, no captions.

item.tests: Tests autonomous short sale-copy writing and talking-head output without inventing offer details or asking for a script.

answer_sheet.Source person: Me, the grey-haired man in portrait-man.jpg.
answer_sheet.Sale details: Mention our sale generally; do not invent discounts, dates or products.

must_haves: The talking presenter remains recognizably the grey-haired man in the attached photo.
An audible, coherent, agent-written English line invites viewers to check out the sale.
The speech contains no invented discount, sale date, product, or other specific offer claim.
The man's mouth visibly moves in sync with the spoken line.
The result is one square, 8-second video with a friendly male voice and no captions.

turns.text: make a talking video from this pic about our sale

dialog.agent:
I can make him talk. Before I start, I need one thing from you:

**What should be said, word for word? Or should I write it from the gist?**

If you want me to write it, tell me about the sale: the store or brand name, the discount (for example "30% off everything"), when it ends, and any website or call to action. Also tell me if you want it in a language other than English.
dialog.why: The assistant asks the user for the exact script or the sale details and waits for a reply before going on.
dialog.user: you write it. just keep it upbeat and say we got a sale going, don't make up any discounts or dates or stuff

turns.agent:
I wrote the script, but your Magic Hour account turned down the video because it doesn't have enough credits. Nothing was made.

**Script (no discounts, dates or other details made up):**
> "Hey everyone! We've got a sale going on right now! Come check it out and grab something you love. Don't miss it!"

**What I tried:** an 8-second video from your photo with him saying the script, at 480p (the free plan's video quality).

**What you can do:**
1. **Add credits** on your Magic Hour account, then tell me to run it again. I'll use the same script and photo. Free plans also cap videos at 5 seconds unless you've bought a credit pack, so a credit pack would let this script run at full length.
2. **Use a shorter script.** For example: *"Hey everyone! We've got a sale going on right now. Come check it out!"* That fits in 5 seconds and costs less, but your current credits may still not cover it.
3. **Use your own recording.** You could record the line yourself. To make him talk with your recording, the account would still need enough credits.

Do you want to add credits and run it again, or switch to the shorter script?
